_about: Reference: when each kind of building draws its trips, as the engine models them. Informational in this release: the scenario compiler holds these values in code (Core/core-legacy/src/scenario.cpp and Core/core-ng/src/network.cpp, where they are part of every world's hashes), and this file documents them; changing it changes nothing.

_help.<kind>.tmax: The windows of a day when the building draws most, each [start, end] as a fraction of the day (0.375 is 09:00). Accepts: a list of pairs of numbers from 0 to 1, start before end.
_help.<kind>.weekend_impact_multiplier: How much of its weekday draw the building keeps at the weekend. Accepts: a number, at least 0 (1 is the same as a weekday).
